title: ID0481177-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / RN 170002799] Rear filter flap spring latch for sid
description: Reported behaviour/issue:  Please identify the part that holds the rear filter flap in the SID in the correct position. It's some kind of spring-loaded latch. I'd also appreciate an email address where I can order these parts, as they're not listed in the spare parts list.
